attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 is the exact original game character portrait/card and sole source authority. Image2 is the user yellow mascot identity reference. Produce one independent full-resolution yellow mascot fusion preserving original composition and aspect ratio.
Actually viewed source-specific features: Small actual photo card. Short swept brown-grey hair, serious closed mouth with fine pale grey upper-lip moustache only and smooth chin. No cap; preserve any actual tiny eyewear detail directly from source without inventing dark frames. Dark outer naval garment, broad pale blue-grey high neckline and original central gold fastening/visible decorations. Preserve near-frontal head, source shadow, exact frame, opaque backing and overlapping cream note with upper dark rows.
Convert the visible character anatomy to a smooth golden-yellow compact round mascot with green-ringed black eyes, retaining original hair/fur contour, brows and only actual source facial hair with exact extent, density and colour. Preserve all real accessories, headgear, clothing details, source head direction, gaze, pose, lighting and crop. Do not infer appearance from filename or biography. No human skin/nose/ears, new beard, hat, people, symbols or decorations.
Match the actual source mouth and expression: a somber downturned mouth remains visibly downturned, a small lip parting remains slightly open, and an open toothy or happy mouth remains open. Do not replace every mouth with the neutral grey reference wedge or an upward smile. Retain subtle asymmetry and brow mood.
Use a compact round head with curved chin resting immediately at the source neckline through a VERY SHORT BROAD transition. Fit existing garment collar and shoulder lines to the mascot, preserving original open/closed fastening. No long yellow stalk, neck roll, pinched ring, floating collar, clipping or cream neck bib. Preserve actual bare/animal clothing state; do not invent a human garment where absent.
Standalone source retains its COMPLETE original painted rectangular backdrop and all original subject/clothing through every edge, fully opaque. Only an original framed card retains that exact tilted frame, wholly opaque backing, cream overlapping note and genuine alpha outside the complete card silhouette. Keep original upper-note multirow markings in their actual position/footprint/contrast as indistinct dark strokes; never erase them into blank parchment, add extra writing or invent readable words/numbers. All original solid surfaces stay fully opaque. Keep full painterly detail and tool output resolution. One asset, no comparison board, new label, text or watermark.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original photograph FRAME AND NOTE silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual tilted photo rectangle, frame rim and overlapping note intact. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.

Direct actual comparison finds no independent grey HAIR moustache in the exact original: the pale upper-lip band is lip/skin light, while current raw invents a thick dense grey moustache. Keep the upper lip and chin clean; do not turn the light lip edge into hair. Also restore the LIGHT BLUE-GREY military uniform visible across the original chest beneath its closed high collar; current return wrongly turns most chest/shoulders into a BLACK heavy overcoat. Preserve short combed grey-brown hair and restore separate source dark/grey eyebrow hairs rather than yellow ridges. Keep original gold central button, restrained single closed mouth, pose and opaque photo/frame/note interior. The auxiliary has matching hair/pose/light closed uniform and supports interpretation, not an additional tool input.
